71SYMS_API SYMS_U64
72syms_dw_hash_from_string(SYMS_String8 string)
73{
74 SYMS_U64 result = 5381;
75 for(SYMS_U64 i = 0; i < string.size; i += 1)
76 {
77 result = ((result << 5) + result) + string.str[i];
78 }
79 return result;
80}

82#if 1
83SYMS_API SYMS_U64
84syms_dw_hash_from_sid(SYMS_SymbolID id)
85{
86 SYMS_U64 low_bit = id & 1;
87 SYMS_U64 chaotic_bits = id & 0x0000000000000007;
88 SYMS_U64 hash = (id >> 3) | (chaotic_bits << 61);
89 for(SYMS_U64 rot = 0; rot < chaotic_bits; rot += 1)
90 {
91 SYMS_U64 lower_portion = hash & 0x1FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;
92 SYMS_U64 low_bit = lower_portion & 1;
93 SYMS_U64 lower_portion_rotated = (low_bit << 60) | (lower_portion >> 1);
94 hash = (hash & 0xE000000000000000) | lower_portion_rotated;
95 }
96 hash = ((hash & 0xE000000000000000) >> 61) | ((hash & 0x1FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) << 3);
97 hash |= low_bit;
98 return hash;
99}
100#elif 0
101SYMS_API SYMS_U64
102syms_dw_hash_from_sid(SYMS_SymbolID id)
103{
104 SYMS_U64 low_bit = id & 1;
105 SYMS_U64 h = (id >> 4) << 1;
106 h &= 0xfffffffffffffffe;
107 h += low_bit;
108 return h;
109}
110#elif 0
111SYMS_API SYMS_U64
112syms_dw_hash_from_sid(SYMS_SymbolID id)
113{
114 SYMS_U64 x = id;
115 SYMS_U64 z = (x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15);
116 z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9;
117 z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111eb;
118 return z ^ (z >> 31);
119}
120#else
121SYMS_API SYMS_U64
122syms_dw_hash_from_sid(SYMS_SymbolID id)
123{
124 SYMS_U64 key = id;
125 key = ~key + (key << 21);
126 key = (key << 21) - key - 1;
127 key = key ^ (key >> 24);
128 key = (key + (key << 3)) + (key << 8);
129 key = key ^ (key >> 14);
130 key = (key + (key << 2)) + (key << 4);
131 key = key ^ (key >> 28);
132 key = key + (key << 31);
133 return key;
134}
135#endif

143SYMS_API SYMS_DwAttribClass
144syms_dw_pick_attrib_value_class(SYMS_DwLanguage lang, SYMS_DwVersion ver, SYMS_DwAttribKind attrib, SYMS_DwFormKind form_kind)
145{
146 // NOTE(rjf): DWARF's spec specifies two mappings:
147 // (SYMS_DwAttribKind) => List(SYMS_DwAttribClass)
148 // (SYMS_DwFormKind) => List(SYMS_DwAttribClass)
149 //
150 // This function's purpose is to find the overlapping class between an
151 // SYMS_DwAttribKind and SYMS_DwFormKind.
152 SYMS_DwAttribClass result = 0;
153 SYMS_DwAttribClass attrib_info;
154 SYMS_DwAttribClass form_info;
155
156 switch(ver)
157 {
158 case SYMS_DwVersion_V1: break;
159 case SYMS_DwVersion_V2:
160 {
161 attrib_info = syms_dw_attrib_class_from_attrib_kind_v2(attrib);
162 form_info = syms_dw_attrib_class_from_form_kind_v2(form_kind);
163
164 // rust compiler writes version 5 attributes
165 if(lang == SYMS_DwLanguage_Rust && (attrib_info == 0 || form_info == 0))
166 {
167 attrib_info = syms_dw_attrib_class_from_attrib_kind(attrib);
168 form_info = syms_dw_attrib_class_from_form_kind(form_kind);
169 }
170 } break;
171 case SYMS_DwVersion_V3:
172 case SYMS_DwVersion_V4:
173 case SYMS_DwVersion_V5:
174 {
175 attrib_info = syms_dw_attrib_class_from_attrib_kind(attrib);
176 form_info = syms_dw_attrib_class_from_form_kind(form_kind);
177 } break;
178 }
179
180 if(attrib_info != 0 && form_info != 0)
181 {
182 result = SYMS_DwAttribClass_UNDEFINED;
183 for(SYMS_U32 i = 0; i < 32; ++i)
184 {
185 SYMS_U32 n = 1u << i;
186 if((attrib_info & n) != 0 && (form_info & n) != 0)
187 {
188 result = ((SYMS_DwAttribClass) n);
189 break;
190 }
191 }
192 }
193
194 return result;
195}

197SYMS_API SYMS_SymbolKind
198syms_dw_symbol_kind_from_tag_stub(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_DwAttribValueResolveParams resolve_params, SYMS_DwTagStub *stub)
199{
200 SYMS_SymbolKind symbol_kind = SYMS_SymbolKind_Null;
201 switch(stub->kind)
202 {
203 //- rjf: procs
204 case SYMS_DwTagKind_INLINED_SUBROUTINE: {symbol_kind = SYMS_SymbolKind_Inline;}break;
205 case SYMS_DwTagKind_SUBPROGRAM:
206 {
207 symbol_kind = SYMS_SymbolKind_Procedure;
208 }break;
209
210 //- rjf: constants
211 case SYMS_DwTagKind_ENUMERATOR:
212 {
213 symbol_kind = SYMS_SymbolKind_Const;
214 }break;
215
216 //- rjf: types
217 case SYMS_DwTagKind_STRUCTURE_TYPE:
218 case SYMS_DwTagKind_UNION_TYPE:
219 case SYMS_DwTagKind_CLASS_TYPE:
220 case SYMS_DwTagKind_VOLATILE_TYPE:
221 case SYMS_DwTagKind_ENUMERATION_TYPE:
222 case SYMS_DwTagKind_TYPEDEF:
223 case SYMS_DwTagKind_POINTER_TYPE:
224 case SYMS_DwTagKind_ARRAY_TYPE:
225 case SYMS_DwTagKind_REFERENCE_TYPE:
226 case SYMS_DwTagKind_STRING_TYPE:
227 case SYMS_DwTagKind_SUBROUTINE_TYPE:
228 case SYMS_DwTagKind_PTR_TO_MEMBER_TYPE:
229 case SYMS_DwTagKind_SUBRANGE_TYPE:
230 case SYMS_DwTagKind_BASE_TYPE:
231 case SYMS_DwTagKind_CONST_TYPE:
232 case SYMS_DwTagKind_RVALUE_REFERENCE_TYPE:
233 symbol_kind = SYMS_SymbolKind_Type; break;
234
235 //- rjf: variables
236 case SYMS_DwTagKind_FORMAL_PARAMETER:
237 symbol_kind = SYMS_SymbolKind_LocalVariable; break;
238
239 //- rjf: variables that could possibly be static
240 case SYMS_DwTagKind_MEMBER:
241 case SYMS_DwTagKind_VARIABLE:
242 {
243 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(0, 0);
244 SYMS_B32 has_external = syms_false;
245 SYMS_B32 has_location = syms_false;
246 SYMS_B32 has_const_val = syms_false;
247 SYMS_DwAttribValue location_value = {SYMS_DwSectionKind_Null};
248 SYMS_DwAttribList attribs = syms_dw_attrib_list_from_stub(scratch.arena, data, dbg, resolve_params.language, resolve_params.version, resolve_params.addr_size, stub);
249 for(SYMS_DwAttribNode *attrib_n = attribs.first;
250 attrib_n != 0;
251 attrib_n = attrib_n->next)
252 {
253 SYMS_DwAttrib *attrib = &attrib_n->attrib;
254 if(attrib->attrib_kind == SYMS_DwAttribKind_EXTERNAL)
255 {
256 has_external = syms_true;
257 }
258 else if(attrib->attrib_kind == SYMS_DwAttribKind_LOCATION)
259 {
260 has_location = syms_true;
261 location_value = syms_dw_attrib_value_from_form_value(data, dbg, resolve_params,
262 attrib->form_kind,
263 attrib->value_class,
264 attrib->form_value);
265 }
266 else if(attrib->attrib_kind == SYMS_DwAttribKind_CONST_VALUE)
267 {
268 has_const_val = syms_true;
269 }
270 }
271
272 SYMS_B32 location_is_fixed_address = syms_false;
273 if(has_location)
274 {
275 void *info_base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Info);
276 SYMS_U64Range loc_rng = syms_make_u64_range(location_value.v[0],
277 location_value.v[0] + location_value.v[1]);
278
279 // TODO(allen): fill this in correctly
280 SYMS_U64 text_base = 0;
281 SYMS_DwSimpleLoc loc = syms_dw_expr__analyze_fast(info_base, loc_rng, text_base);
282 location_is_fixed_address = (loc.kind == SYMS_DwSimpleLocKind_Address);
283 }
284
285 if(has_const_val)
286 {
287 symbol_kind = SYMS_SymbolKind_Const;
288 }
289 else if(location_is_fixed_address)
290 {
291 symbol_kind = SYMS_SymbolKind_ImageRelativeVariable;
292 }
293 else if(!has_external && !location_is_fixed_address)
294 {
295 symbol_kind = SYMS_SymbolKind_LocalVariable;
296 }
297 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
298 }break;
299
300 //- rjf: scopes
301 case SYMS_DwTagKind_LEXICAL_BLOCK:
302 symbol_kind = SYMS_SymbolKind_Scope; break;
303
304 default: break;
305 }
306 return symbol_kind;
307}

309SYMS_API SYMS_SecInfoArray
310syms_dw_copy_sec_info_array(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_SecInfoArray array)
311{
312 SYMS_SecInfoArray result = {0};
313 result.count = array.count;
314 result.sec_info = syms_push_array_zero(arena, SYMS_SecInfo, result.count);
315 for(SYMS_U64 idx = 0; idx < array.count; idx += 1)
316 {
317 result.sec_info[idx].vrange = array.sec_info[idx].vrange;
318 result.sec_info[idx].frange = array.sec_info[idx].frange;
319 result.sec_info[idx].name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, array.sec_info[idx].name);
320 }
321 return result;
322}

324SYMS_API SYMS_String8
325syms_dw_path_from_dir_and_filename(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 dir, SYMS_String8 filename)
326{
327 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
328 SYMS_String8List pieces = {0};
329 SYMS_U8 slash_char = '/';
330
331 //- rjf: get pieces of full path from dir
332 SYMS_B32 starts_with_slash = 0;
333 {
334 SYMS_U64 start = 0;
335 for(SYMS_U64 idx = 0; idx <= dir.size; idx += 1)
336 {
337 if(idx == dir.size && idx > start)
338 {
339 SYMS_String8 str = syms_str8(dir.str+start, idx-start);
340 syms_string_list_push(scratch.arena, &pieces, str);
341 }
342 else if(idx < dir.size && (dir.str[idx] == '/' || dir.str[idx] == '\\'))
343 {
344 if(idx == 0)
345 {
346 starts_with_slash = 1;
347 }
348 if(dir.str[idx] == '\\')
349 {
350 slash_char = '\\';
351 }
352 if(idx - start != 0)
353 {
354 SYMS_String8 str = syms_str8(dir.str+start, idx-start);
355 syms_string_list_push(scratch.arena, &pieces, str);
356 }
357 start = idx+1;
358 }
359 }
360 }
361
362 //- rjf: get pieces of full path from filename
363 {
364 SYMS_U64 start = 0;
365 for(SYMS_U64 idx = 0; idx <= filename.size; idx += 1)
366 {
367 if(idx == filename.size && idx > start)
368 {
369 SYMS_String8 str = syms_str8(filename.str+start, idx-start);
370 syms_string_list_push(scratch.arena, &pieces, str);
371 }
372 else if(idx < filename.size && (filename.str[idx] == '/' || filename.str[idx] == '\\'))
373 {
374 if(idx - start != 0)
375 {
376 SYMS_String8 str = syms_str8(filename.str+start, idx-start);
377 syms_string_list_push(scratch.arena, &pieces, str);
378 }
379 start = idx+1;
380 }
381 }
382 }
383
384 SYMS_String8 result = {0};
385 SYMS_StringJoin join = {0};
386 join.pre = starts_with_slash ? syms_str8_lit("/") : syms_str8_lit("");
387 join.sep = syms_str8(&slash_char, 1);
388 result = syms_string_list_join(arena, &pieces, &join);
389 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
390 return result;
391}

393SYMS_API void
394syms_dw_symbol_id_chunk_list_push(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_DwSymbolIDChunkList *list, SYMS_SymbolID sid)
395{
396 SYMS_DwSymbolIDChunk *chunk = list->last;
397 if(chunk == 0 || chunk->count >= SYMS_ARRAY_SIZE(chunk->ids))
398 {
399 chunk = syms_push_array_zero(arena, SYMS_DwSymbolIDChunk, 1);
400 SYMS_QueuePush(list->first, list->last, chunk);
401 list->chunk_count += 1;
402 }
403 chunk->ids[chunk->count] = sid;
404 chunk->count += 1;
405 list->total_id_count += 1;
406}

408SYMS_API SYMS_SymbolIDArray
409syms_dw_sid_array_from_chunk_list(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_DwSymbolIDChunkList list)
410{
411 SYMS_SymbolIDArray array = {0};
412 array.count = list.total_id_count;
413 array.ids = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_SymbolID, array.count);
414 SYMS_U64 idx = 0;
415 for(SYMS_DwSymbolIDChunk *chunk = list.first; chunk != 0; chunk = chunk->next)
416 {
417 syms_memmove(array.ids + idx, chunk->ids, chunk->count*sizeof(SYMS_SymbolID));
418 idx += chunk->count;
419 }
420 return array;
421}

426SYMS_API SYMS_U64
427syms_dw_based_range_read_length(void *base, SYMS_U64Range range, SYMS_U64 offset, SYMS_U64 *out_value)
428{
429 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = 0;
430 SYMS_U64 value = 0;
431 SYMS_U32 first32 = 0;
432 if(syms_based_range_read_struct(base, range, offset, &first32))
433 {
434 // NOTE(rjf): DWARF 32-bit => use the first 32 bits as the size.
435 if(first32 != 0xffffffff)
436 {
437 value = (SYMS_U64)first32;
438 bytes_read = sizeof(SYMS_U32);
439 }
440 // NOTE(rjf): DWARF 64-bit => first 32 are just a marker, use the next 64 bits as the size.
441 else if(syms_based_range_read_struct(base, range, offset + sizeof(SYMS_U32), &value))
442 {
443 value = 0;
444 bytes_read = sizeof(SYMS_U32) + sizeof(SYMS_U64);
445 }
446 }
447 if(out_value != 0)
448 {
449 *out_value = value;
450 }
451 return bytes_read;
452}

454SYMS_API SYMS_U64
455syms_dw_based_range_read_abbrev_tag(void *base, SYMS_U64Range range, SYMS_U64 offset, SYMS_DwAbbrev *out_abbrev)
456{
457 SYMS_U64 total_bytes_read = 0;
458
459 //- rjf: parse ID
460 SYMS_U64 id_off = offset;
461 SYMS_U64 sub_kind_off = id_off;
462 SYMS_U64 id = 0;
463 {
464 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, range, id_off, &id);
465 sub_kind_off += bytes_read;
466 total_bytes_read += bytes_read;
467 }
468
469 //- rjf: parse sub-kind
470 SYMS_U64 sub_kind = 0;
471 SYMS_U64 next_off = sub_kind_off;
472 if(id != 0)
473 {
474 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, range, sub_kind_off, &sub_kind);
475 next_off += bytes_read;
476 total_bytes_read += bytes_read;
477 }
478
479 //- rjf: parse whether this tag has children
480 SYMS_U8 has_children = 0;
481 if(id != 0)
482 {
483 total_bytes_read += syms_based_range_read_struct(base, range, next_off, &has_children);
484 }
485
486 //- rjf: fill abbrev
487 if(out_abbrev != 0)
488 {
489 SYMS_DwAbbrev abbrev;
490 syms_memzero_struct(&abbrev);
491 abbrev.kind = SYMS_DwAbbrevKind_Tag;
492 abbrev.abbrev_range = syms_make_u64_range(range.min+offset, range.min+offset+total_bytes_read);
493 abbrev.sub_kind = sub_kind;
494 abbrev.id = id;
495 if(has_children)
496 {
497 abbrev.flags |= SYMS_DwAbbrevFlag_HasChildren;
498 }
499 *out_abbrev = abbrev;
500 }
501
502 return total_bytes_read;
503}

505SYMS_API SYMS_U64
506syms_dw_based_range_read_abbrev_attrib_info(void *base, SYMS_U64Range range, SYMS_U64 offset, SYMS_DwAbbrev *out_abbrev)
507{
508 SYMS_U64 total_bytes_read = 0;
509
510 //- rjf: parse ID
511 SYMS_U64 id_off = offset;
512 SYMS_U64 sub_kind_off = id_off;
513 SYMS_U64 id = 0;
514 {
515 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, range, id_off, &id);
516 sub_kind_off += bytes_read;
517 total_bytes_read += bytes_read;
518 }
519
520 //- rjf: parse sub-kind (form-kind)
521 SYMS_U64 sub_kind = 0;
522 SYMS_U64 next_off = sub_kind_off;
523 {
524 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, range, sub_kind_off, &sub_kind);
525 next_off += bytes_read;
526 total_bytes_read += bytes_read;
527 }
528
529 //- rjf: parse implicit const
530 SYMS_U64 implicit_const = 0;
531 if(sub_kind == SYMS_DwFormKind_IMPLICIT_CONST)
532 {
533 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, range, next_off, &implicit_const);
534 total_bytes_read += bytes_read;
535 }
536
537 //- rjf: fill abbrev
538 if(out_abbrev != 0)
539 {
540 SYMS_DwAbbrev abbrev;
541 syms_memzero_struct(&abbrev);
542 abbrev.kind = SYMS_DwAbbrevKind_Attrib;
543 abbrev.abbrev_range = syms_make_u64_range(offset, offset+total_bytes_read);
544 abbrev.sub_kind = sub_kind;
545 abbrev.id = id;
546 if(sub_kind == SYMS_DwFormKind_IMPLICIT_CONST)
547 {
548 abbrev.flags |= SYMS_DwAbbrevFlag_HasImplicitConst;
549 abbrev.const_value = implicit_const;
550 }
551 *out_abbrev = abbrev;
552 }
553
554 return total_bytes_read;
555}

557SYMS_API SYMS_U64
558syms_dw_based_range_read_attrib_form_value(void *base, SYMS_U64Range range, SYMS_U64 offset, SYMS_DwMode mode, SYMS_U64 address_size, SYMS_DwFormKind form_kind, SYMS_U64 implicit_const, SYMS_DwAttribValue *form_value_out)
559{
560 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = 0;
561 SYMS_U64 bytes_to_read = 0;
562 SYMS_DwAttribValue form_value;
563 syms_memzero_struct(&form_value);
564
565 switch(form_kind)
566 {
567
568 //- rjf: 1-byte uint reads
569 case SYMS_DwFormKind_REF1: case SYMS_DwFormKind_DATA1: case SYMS_DwFormKind_FLAG:
570 case SYMS_DwFormKind_STRX1: case SYMS_DwFormKind_ADDRX1:
571 bytes_to_read = 1; goto read_fixed_uint;
572
573 //- rjf: 2-byte uint reads
574 case SYMS_DwFormKind_REF2: case SYMS_DwFormKind_DATA2: case SYMS_DwFormKind_STRX2:
575 case SYMS_DwFormKind_ADDRX2:
576 bytes_to_read = 2; goto read_fixed_uint;
577
578 //- rjf: 3-byte uint reads
579 case SYMS_DwFormKind_STRX3: case SYMS_DwFormKind_ADDRX3:
580 bytes_to_read = 3; goto read_fixed_uint;
581
582 //- rjf: 4-byte uint reads
583 case SYMS_DwFormKind_DATA4: case SYMS_DwFormKind_REF4: case SYMS_DwFormKind_REF_SUP4: case SYMS_DwFormKind_STRX4: case SYMS_DwFormKind_ADDRX4:
584 bytes_to_read = 4; goto read_fixed_uint;
585
586 //- rjf: 8-byte uint reads
587 case SYMS_DwFormKind_DATA8: case SYMS_DwFormKind_REF8: case SYMS_DwFormKind_REF_SIG8: case SYMS_DwFormKind_REF_SUP8:
588 bytes_to_read = 8; goto read_fixed_uint;
589
590 //- rjf: address-size reads
591 case SYMS_DwFormKind_ADDR: bytes_to_read = address_size; goto read_fixed_uint;
592
593 //- rjf: offset-size reads
594 case SYMS_DwFormKind_REF_ADDR: case SYMS_DwFormKind_SEC_OFFSET: case SYMS_DwFormKind_LINE_STRP:
595 case SYMS_DwFormKind_STRP: case SYMS_DwFormKind_STRP_SUP:
596 bytes_to_read = syms_dw_offset_size_from_mode(mode); goto read_fixed_uint;
597
598 //- rjf: fixed-size uint reads
599 {
600 read_fixed_uint:;
601 SYMS_U64 value = 0;
602 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read(base, range, offset, bytes_to_read, &value);
603 form_value.v[0] = value;
604 }break;
605
606 //- rjf: uleb128 reads
607 case SYMS_DwFormKind_UDATA: case SYMS_DwFormKind_REF_UDATA: case SYMS_DwFormKind_STRX:
608 case SYMS_DwFormKind_ADDRX: case SYMS_DwFormKind_LOCLISTX: case SYMS_DwFormKind_RNGLISTX:
609 {
610 SYMS_U64 value = 0;
611 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, range, offset, &value);
612 form_value.v[0] = value;
613 }break;
614
615 //- rjf: sleb128 reads
616 case SYMS_DwFormKind_SDATA:
617 {
618 SYMS_S64 value = 0;
619 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read_sleb128(base, range, offset, &value);
620 form_value.v[0] = value;
621 }break;
622
623 //- rjf: fixed-size uint read + skip
624 case SYMS_DwFormKind_BLOCK1: bytes_to_read = 1; goto read_fixed_uint_skip;
625 case SYMS_DwFormKind_BLOCK2: bytes_to_read = 2; goto read_fixed_uint_skip;
626 case SYMS_DwFormKind_BLOCK4: bytes_to_read = 4; goto read_fixed_uint_skip;
627 {
628 read_fixed_uint_skip:;
629 SYMS_U64 size = 0;
630 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read(base, range, offset, bytes_to_read, &size);
631 form_value.v[0] = size;
632 form_value.v[1] = offset;
633 bytes_read += size;
634 }break;
635
636 //- rjf: uleb 128 read + skip
637 case SYMS_DwFormKind_BLOCK:
638 {
639 SYMS_U64 size = 0;
640 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, range, offset, &size);
641 form_value.v[0] = size;
642 form_value.v[1] = offset;
643 bytes_read += size;
644 }break;
645
646 //- rjf: u64 ranges
647 case SYMS_DwFormKind_DATA16:
648 {
649 SYMS_U64 value1 = 0;
650 SYMS_U64 value2 = 0;
651 bytes_read += syms_based_range_read_struct(base, range, offset, &value1);
652 bytes_read += syms_based_range_read_struct(base, range, offset + sizeof(SYMS_U64), &value2);
653 form_value.v[0] = value1;
654 form_value.v[1] = value2;
655 }break;
656
657 //- rjf: strings
658 case SYMS_DwFormKind_STRING:
659 {
660 SYMS_String8 string = syms_based_range_read_string(base, range, offset);
661 bytes_read = string.size + 1;
662 SYMS_U64 string_offset = offset;
663 SYMS_U64 string_size = (offset + bytes_read) - string_offset;
664 form_value.v[0] = string_offset;
665 form_value.v[1] = string_offset+string_size-1;
666 }break;
667
668 //- rjf: implicit const
669 case SYMS_DwFormKind_IMPLICIT_CONST:
670 {
671 // NOTE(nick): This is special case.
672 // Unlike other forms that have their values stored in the .debug_info section,
673 // This one defines it's value in the .debug_abbrev section.
674 form_value.v[0] = implicit_const;
675 }break;
676
677 //- rjf: expr loc
678 case SYMS_DwFormKind_EXPRLOC:
679 {
680 SYMS_U64 size = 0;
681 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, range, offset, &size);
682 form_value.v[0] = offset + bytes_read;
683 form_value.v[1] = size;
684 bytes_read += size;
685 }break;
686
687 //- rjf: flag present
688 case SYMS_DwFormKind_FLAG_PRESENT:
689 {
690 form_value.v[0] = 1;
691 }break;
692
693 case SYMS_DwFormKind_INDIRECT:
694 {
695 SYMS_INVALID_CODE_PATH;
696 }break;
697
698 case SYMS_DwFormKind_INVALID:
699 {
700 }break;
701 }
702
703 if(form_value_out != 0)
704 {
705 *form_value_out = form_value;
706 }
707
708 return bytes_read;
709}

712//~ rjf: Debug Info Accelerator (DbgAccel) code
713
714//- rjf: debug info and interaction with ELF file accel
715
716SYMS_API SYMS_B32
717syms_dw_elf_bin_accel_is_dbg(SYMS_ElfBinAccel *bin_accel)
718{
719 SYMS_B32 result = syms_false;
720 SYMS_String8 required_sections[] =
721 {
722 syms_str8_comp(".debug_info"),
723 };
724 for(SYMS_U64 required_section_idx = 0;
725 required_section_idx < SYMS_ARRAY_SIZE(required_sections);
726 required_section_idx += 1)
727 {
728 SYMS_B32 found = syms_false;
729 for(SYMS_U64 section_idx = 0;
730 section_idx < bin_accel->sections.count;
731 section_idx += 1)
732 {
733 if(syms_string_match(required_sections[required_section_idx], bin_accel->sections.v[section_idx].name, 0))
734 {
735 found = syms_true;
736 break;
737 }
738 }
739 if(found)
740 {
741 result = syms_true;
742 }
743 else
744 {
745 result = syms_false;
746 break;
747 }
748 }
749 return result;
750}
751
752SYMS_API SYMS_B32
753syms_dw_mach_bin_accel_is_dbg(SYMS_MachBinAccel *bin_accel)
754{
755 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(0,0);
756 SYMS_B32 is_dbg = syms_false;
757 SYMS_SecInfoArray sec_array = syms_mach_sec_info_array_from_bin(scratch.arena, syms_str8(0,0), bin_accel);
758 for(SYMS_U64 i = 0; i < sec_array.count; i += 1)
759 {
760 if(syms_string_match(sec_array.sec_info[i].name, syms_str8_lit("__debug_info"), 0) ||
761 syms_string_match(sec_array.sec_info[i].name, syms_str8_lit("__debug_line"), 0))
762 {
763 is_dbg = syms_true;
764 break;
765 }
766 }
767 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
768 return is_dbg;
769}
770
771SYMS_API SYMS_DwDbgAccel *
772syms_dw_dbg_accel_from_sec_info_array(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_U64 vbase, SYMS_Arch arch, SYMS_SecInfoArray sections)
773{
774 //- rjf: scan file accel for info and abbrev sections, which are all that is necessary for
775 // some useful debug info to come from DWARF.
776 SYMS_B32 has_necessary_sections = syms_false;
777 {
778 SYMS_DwSectionKind necessary_kinds[] =
779 {
780 SYMS_DwSectionKind_Info,
781 SYMS_DwSectionKind_Abbrev
782 };
783 SYMS_U32 match_count = 0;
784 for (SYMS_U64 kind_idx = 0; kind_idx < SYMS_ARRAY_SIZE(necessary_kinds); kind_idx += 1)
785 {
786 SYMS_String8 dw_name = syms_dw_name_string_from_section_kind(necessary_kinds[kind_idx]);
787 SYMS_String8 dwo_name = syms_dw_dwo_name_string_from_section_kind(necessary_kinds[kind_idx]);
788 SYMS_String8 dw_mach_name = syms_dw_mach_name_string_from_section_kind(necessary_kinds[kind_idx]);
789 for(SYMS_U64 section_idx = 0; section_idx < sections.count; section_idx += 1)
790 {
791 if(syms_string_match(sections.sec_info[section_idx].name, dw_name, 0) ||
792 syms_string_match(sections.sec_info[section_idx].name, dwo_name, 0) ||
793 syms_string_match(sections.sec_info[section_idx].name, dw_mach_name, 0))
794 {
795 match_count += 1;
796 break;
797 }
798 }
799 }
800 has_necessary_sections = (match_count == SYMS_ARRAY_SIZE(necessary_kinds));
801 }
802
803 //- rjf: scan sections for .text section, so we can store its index (useful for
804 // later stuff in the expression transpiler)
805 SYMS_U64 text_section_idx = 0;
806 for(SYMS_U64 idx = 0; idx < sections.count; idx += 1)
807 {
808 if(syms_string_match(sections.sec_info[idx].name, syms_str8_lit(".text"), 0))
809 {
810 text_section_idx = idx;
811 break;
812 }
813 }
814
815 //- rjf: build section map
816 SYMS_DwSection *section_map = 0;
817 SYMS_B32 is_dwo = syms_false;
818 if(has_necessary_sections)
819 {
820 section_map = syms_push_array_zero(arena, SYMS_DwSection, SYMS_DwSectionKind_COUNT);
821 for(SYMS_DwSectionKind section_kind = (SYMS_DwSectionKind)(SYMS_DwSectionKind_Null+1);
822 section_kind < SYMS_DwSectionKind_COUNT;
823 section_kind = (SYMS_DwSectionKind)(section_kind + 1))
824 {
825 SYMS_String8 section_kind_name = syms_dw_name_string_from_section_kind(section_kind);
826 SYMS_String8 dwo_section_kind_name = syms_dw_dwo_name_string_from_section_kind(section_kind);
827 SYMS_String8 mach_kind_name = syms_dw_mach_name_string_from_section_kind(section_kind);
828 for(SYMS_U64 section_idx = 0; section_idx < sections.count; section_idx += 1)
829 {
830 SYMS_B32 match_main = syms_string_match(sections.sec_info[section_idx].name, section_kind_name, 0);
831 SYMS_B32 match_dwo = syms_string_match(sections.sec_info[section_idx].name, dwo_section_kind_name, 0);
832 SYMS_B32 match_mach = syms_string_match(sections.sec_info[section_idx].name, mach_kind_name, 0);
833 if(match_main || match_dwo || match_mach)
834 {
835 section_map[section_kind].range = sections.sec_info[section_idx].frange;
836 if(match_dwo && section_kind == SYMS_DwSectionKind_Info)
837 {
838 is_dwo = syms_true;
839 }
840 break;
841 }
842 }
843 }
844 }
845
846 //- rjf: find acceptable vrange for this file, to detect busted line info sections later
847 SYMS_U64Range acceptable_vrange = {0};
848 if(has_necessary_sections)
849 {
850 for(SYMS_U64 idx = 0; idx < sections.count; idx += 1)
851 {
852 acceptable_vrange.min = SYMS_MIN(acceptable_vrange.min, sections.sec_info[idx].vrange.min);
853 acceptable_vrange.max = SYMS_MAX(acceptable_vrange.max, sections.sec_info[idx].vrange.max);
854 }
855 }
856
857 //- rjf: find .debug_info and .debug_aranges for initial quick parse
858 void *info_base = 0;
859 SYMS_U64Range info_rng = {0};
860 SYMS_DwMode aranges_mode = SYMS_DwMode_Null;
861 void *aranges_base = 0;
862 SYMS_U64Range aranges_rng = {0};
863 if(has_necessary_sections)
864 {
865 info_base = data.str + section_map[SYMS_DwSectionKind_Info].range.min;
866 info_rng = syms_make_u64_range(0, syms_u64_range_size(section_map[SYMS_DwSectionKind_Info].range));
867 aranges_mode = syms_dw_mode_from_sec(section_map, SYMS_DwSectionKind_ARanges);
868 aranges_base = data.str + section_map[SYMS_DwSectionKind_ARanges].range.min;
869 aranges_rng = syms_make_u64_range(0, syms_u64_range_size(section_map[SYMS_DwSectionKind_ARanges].range));
870 }
871
872 //- rjf: parse comp unit range info from .debug_info and .debug_aranges
873 SYMS_U64 unit_count = 0;
874 SYMS_DwUnitRangeInfo *unit_range_info = 0;
875 if(has_necessary_sections)
876 {
877 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
878
879 //- rjf: get all comp unit file ranges
880 SYMS_U64RangeList unit_franges = {0};
881 {
882 for(SYMS_U64 offset = 0;;)
883 {
884 SYMS_U64 info_size = 0;
885 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_dw_based_range_read_length(info_base, info_rng, offset, &info_size);
886 if(info_size == 0)
887 {
888 break;
889 }
890 SYMS_U64 total_info_size = info_size + bytes_read;
891 SYMS_U64 info_start = info_rng.min + offset;
892 SYMS_U64Range range = syms_make_u64_range(info_start, info_start + total_info_size);
893 syms_u64_range_list_push(scratch.arena, &unit_franges, range);
894 offset += total_info_size;
895 }
896 }
897 unit_count = unit_franges.node_count;
898
899 //- rjf: get all comp unit addr ranges via .debug_aranges
900 SYMS_U64RangeArray *unit_aranges = syms_push_array_zero(scratch.arena, SYMS_U64RangeArray, unit_count);
901 {
902 for(SYMS_U64 offset = 0; offset < aranges_rng.max;)
903 {
904 // rjf: parse hdr
905 SYMS_U64 unit_length = 0;
906 SYMS_U16 version = 0;
907 SYMS_U64 debug_info_offset = 0;
908 SYMS_U8 address_size = 0;
909 SYMS_U8 segment_size = 0;
910 offset += syms_dw_based_range_read_length(aranges_base, aranges_rng, offset, &unit_length);
911 offset += syms_based_range_read_struct(aranges_base, aranges_rng, offset, &version);
912 offset += syms_based_range_read(aranges_base, aranges_rng, offset, syms_dw_offset_size_from_mode(aranges_mode), &debug_info_offset);
913 offset += syms_based_range_read_struct(aranges_base, aranges_rng, offset, &address_size);
914 offset += syms_based_range_read_struct(aranges_base, aranges_rng, offset, &segment_size);
915
916 // rjf: figure out which UID we're looking at
917 SYMS_UnitID uid = 0;
918 SYMS_U64 unit_idx = 0;
919 {
920 for(SYMS_U64RangeNode *n = unit_franges.first; n != 0; n = n->next, unit_idx += 1)
921 {
922 if(n->range.min <= debug_info_offset && debug_info_offset < n->range.max)
923 {
924 uid = unit_idx+1;
925 break;
926 }
927 }
928 }
929
930 // rjf: figure out tuple size
931 SYMS_U64 tuple_size = address_size*2 + segment_size;
932
933 // rjf: adjust parsing offset to be divisible by the tuple size (see the February 13, 2017 spec)
934 SYMS_U64 bytes_too_far_past_boundary = offset%tuple_size;
935 if(bytes_too_far_past_boundary)
936 {
937 offset += (tuple_size - bytes_too_far_past_boundary);
938 }
939
940 // rjf: parse tuples
941 SYMS_U64RangeList rngs = {0};
942 {
943 for(;;)
944 {
945 SYMS_U64 segment = 0;
946 SYMS_U64 address = 0;
947 SYMS_U64 length = 0;
948 offset += syms_based_range_read(aranges_base, aranges_rng, offset, segment_size, &segment);
949 offset += syms_based_range_read(aranges_base, aranges_rng, offset, address_size, &address);
950 offset += syms_based_range_read(aranges_base, aranges_rng, offset, address_size, &length);
951 if(segment == 0 && address == 0 && length == 0)
952 {
953 break;
954 }
955 if(length != 0 && acceptable_vrange.min <= address && address < acceptable_vrange.max)
956 {
957 SYMS_U64Range rng = syms_make_u64_range(address, address+length);
958 syms_u64_range_list_push(scratch.arena, &rngs, rng);
959 }
960 }
961 }
962
963 // rjf: fill unit_aranges slot
964 unit_aranges[unit_idx] = syms_u64_range_array_from_list(arena, &rngs);
965
966 // rjf: log
967#if SYMS_ENABLE_DEV_LOG
968 SYMS_LogOpen(SYMS_LogFeature_DwarfUnitRanges, uid, rnglog);
969 {
970 SYMS_Log(".debug_aranges [unit #%i]:\n", uid);
971 for(SYMS_U64 idx = 0; idx < unit_aranges[unit_idx].count; idx += 1)
972 {
973 SYMS_Log(" [0x%" SYMS_PRIx64 ", 0x%" SYMS_PRIx64 ")\n", unit_aranges[unit_idx].ranges[idx].min, unit_aranges[unit_idx].ranges[idx].max);
974 }
975 }
976 SYMS_LogClose(rnglog);
977#endif
978 }
979 }
980
981 //- rjf: build range info array
982 unit_range_info = syms_push_array_zero(arena, SYMS_DwUnitRangeInfo, unit_franges.node_count);
983 {
984 SYMS_U64RangeNode *frange_node = unit_franges.first;
985 for(SYMS_U64 unit_idx = 0;
986 unit_idx < unit_franges.node_count && frange_node != 0;
987 unit_idx += 1, frange_node = frange_node->next)
988 {
989 unit_range_info[unit_idx].uid = unit_idx+1;
990 unit_range_info[unit_idx].frange = frange_node->range;
991 unit_range_info[unit_idx].addr_ranges = unit_aranges[unit_idx];
992 }
993 }
994
995 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
996 }
997
998 //- rjf: fill+return
999 SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg = (SYMS_DwDbgAccel*)&syms_format_nil;
1000 if(has_necessary_sections)
1001 {
1002 dbg = syms_push_array_zero(arena, SYMS_DwDbgAccel, 1);
1003 dbg->format = SYMS_FileFormat_DWARF;
1004 dbg->arch = arch;
1005 dbg->vbase = vbase;
1006 dbg->sections = syms_dw_copy_sec_info_array(arena, sections);
1007 dbg->text_section_idx = text_section_idx;
1008 dbg->acceptable_vrange = acceptable_vrange;
1009 dbg->section_map = section_map;
1010 dbg->unit_count = unit_count;
1011 dbg->unit_range_info = unit_range_info;
1012 dbg->is_dwo = is_dwo;
1013 }
1014 return dbg;
1015}

1017SYMS_API SYMS_DwDbgAccel *
1018syms_dw_dbg_accel_from_elf_bin(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_ElfBinAccel *bin)
1019{
1020 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
1021 SYMS_SecInfoArray sec_info_array = syms_elf_sec_info_array_from_bin(scratch.arena, data, bin);
1022 SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg = syms_dw_dbg_accel_from_sec_info_array(arena, data, syms_elf_default_vbase_from_bin(bin), bin->header.arch, sec_info_array);
1023 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
1024 return dbg;
1025}

1027SYMS_API SYMS_DwDbgAccel *
1028syms_dw_dbg_accel_from_mach_bin(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MachBinAccel *bin)
1029{
1030 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
1031 SYMS_SecInfoArray sec_info_array = syms_mach_sec_info_array_from_bin(scratch.arena, data, bin);
1032 SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg = syms_dw_dbg_accel_from_sec_info_array(arena, data, syms_mach_default_vbase_from_bin(bin), bin->arch, sec_info_array);
1033 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
1034 return dbg;

1037SYMS_API SYMS_ExtFileList
1038syms_dw_ext_file_list_from_dbg(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg)
1039{
1040 SYMS_ExtFileList list;
1041 syms_memzero_struct(&list);
1042 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
1043 SYMS_DwUnitSetAccel *unit_set = syms_dw_unit_set_accel_from_dbg(scratch.arena, data, dbg);
1044 SYMS_U64 count = syms_dw_unit_count_from_set(unit_set);
1045 for(SYMS_U64 unit_num = 1; unit_num <= count; unit_num += 1)
1046 {
1047 SYMS_UnitID uid = syms_dw_uid_from_number(unit_set, unit_num);
1048 SYMS_DwCompRoot *root = syms_dw_comp_root_from_uid(unit_set, uid);
1049 SYMS_DwExtDebugRef ext_ref = syms_dw_ext_debug_ref_from_comp_root(root);
1050 if(ext_ref.dwo_path.size != 0)
1051 {
1052 SYMS_ExtFileNode *node = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_ExtFileNode, 1);
1053 node->ext_file.file_name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, ext_ref.dwo_path);
1054 syms_memzero_struct(&node->ext_file.match_key);
1055 syms_memmove(node->ext_file.match_key.v, &ext_ref.dwo_id, sizeof(SYMS_U64));
1056 SYMS_QueuePush(list.first, list.last, node);
1057 list.node_count += 1;
1058 }
1059 }
1060 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
1061 return list;
1062}

1064SYMS_API SYMS_SecInfoArray
1065syms_dw_sec_info_array_from_dbg(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg)
1066{
1067 SYMS_SecInfoArray result = syms_dw_copy_sec_info_array(arena, dbg->sections);
1068 return result;
1069}

1071SYMS_API SYMS_ExtMatchKey
1072syms_dw_ext_match_key_from_dbg(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg)
1073{
1074 SYMS_ExtMatchKey key;
1075 syms_memzero_struct(&key);
1076 if(dbg->is_dwo)
1077 {
1078 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(0, 0);
1079 SYMS_ExtFileList ext_files = syms_dw_ext_file_list_from_dbg(scratch.arena, data, dbg);
1080 if(ext_files.node_count != 0)
1081 {
1082 SYMS_ExtFileNode *n = ext_files.first;
1083 key = n->ext_file.match_key;;
1084 }
1085 syms_arena_temp_end(scratch);
1086 }
1087 else
1088 {
1089 SYMS_U32 checksum = syms_elf_gnu_debuglink_crc32(0, data);
1090 syms_memmove(key.v, &checksum, sizeof(checksum));
1091 }
1092 return key;
1093}

1095SYMS_API SYMS_U64
1096syms_dw_default_vbase_from_dbg(SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg)
1097{
1098 return dbg->vbase;

1101//- rjf: top-level unit info
1102
1103SYMS_API SYMS_UnitID
1104syms_dw_uid_from_foff(SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_U64 foff)
1105{
1106 SYMS_UnitID uid = 0;
1107 for(SYMS_U64 unit_idx = 0; unit_idx < dbg->unit_count; unit_idx += 1)
1108 {
1109 if(dbg->unit_range_info[unit_idx].frange.min <= foff && foff < dbg->unit_range_info[unit_idx].frange.max)
1110 {
1111 uid = unit_idx+1;
1112 break;
1113 }
1114 }
1115 return uid;
1116}

1118//- rjf: important DWARF section base/range accessors
1119
1120SYMS_API SYMS_DwMode
1121syms_dw_mode_from_sec(SYMS_DwSection *section_map, SYMS_DwSectionKind kind)
1122{
1123 SYMS_U64Range range = section_map[kind].range;
1124 SYMS_U64 size = range.max - range.min;
1125 if(size > 0xffffffff)
1126 {
1127 return SYMS_DwMode_64Bit;
1128 }
1129 else
1130 {
1131 return SYMS_DwMode_32Bit;
1132 }
1133}

1136syms_dw_sec_is_present(SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind kind)
1137{
1138 SYMS_U64Range *range = &dbg->section_map[kind].range;
1139 SYMS_B32 result = (range->max > range->min);
1140 return(result);

1156//~ rjf: Abbrev Table
1157
1158SYMS_API SYMS_DwAbbrevTable
1159syms_dw_make_abbrev_table(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_U64 abbrev_offset)
1160{
1161 void *file_base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Abbrev);
1162 SYMS_U64Range abbrev_range = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Abbrev);
1163
1164 SYMS_DwAbbrevTable table;
1165 syms_memzero_struct(&table);
1166
1167 //- rjf: count the tags we have
1168 SYMS_U64 tag_count = 0;
1169 for(SYMS_U64 abbrev_read_off = abbrev_offset - abbrev_range.min;;)
1170 {
1171 SYMS_DwAbbrev tag;
1172 {
1173 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_dw_based_range_read_abbrev_tag(file_base, abbrev_range, abbrev_read_off, &tag);
1174 abbrev_read_off += bytes_read;
1175 if(bytes_read == 0 || tag.id == 0)
1176 {
1177 break;
1178 }
1179 }
1180 for(;;)
1181 {
1182 SYMS_DwAbbrev attrib;
1183 syms_memzero_struct(&attrib);
1184 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_dw_based_range_read_abbrev_attrib_info(file_base, abbrev_range, abbrev_read_off, &attrib);
1185 abbrev_read_off += bytes_read;
1186 if(bytes_read == 0 || attrib.id == 0)
1187 {
1188 break;
1189 }
1190 }
1191 tag_count += 1;
1192 }
1193
1194 //- rjf: build table
1195 table.count = tag_count;
1196 table.entries = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_DwAbbrevTableEntry, table.count);
1197 syms_memset(table.entries, 0, sizeof(SYMS_DwAbbrevTableEntry)*table.count);
1198 SYMS_U64 tag_idx = 0;
1199 for(SYMS_U64 abbrev_read_off = abbrev_offset - abbrev_range.min;;)
1200 {
1201 SYMS_DwAbbrev tag;
1202 {
1203 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_dw_based_range_read_abbrev_tag(file_base, abbrev_range, abbrev_read_off, &tag);
1204 abbrev_read_off += bytes_read;
1205 if(bytes_read == 0 || tag.id == 0)
1206 {
1207 break;
1208 }
1209 }
1210
1211 // rjf: insert this tag into the table
1212 {
1213 table.entries[tag_idx].id = tag.id;
1214 table.entries[tag_idx].off = tag.abbrev_range.min;
1215 tag_idx += 1;
1216 }
1217
1218 for(;;)
1219 {
1220 SYMS_DwAbbrev attrib;
1221 syms_memzero_struct(&attrib);
1222 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_dw_based_range_read_abbrev_attrib_info(file_base, abbrev_range, abbrev_read_off, &attrib);
1223 abbrev_read_off += bytes_read;
1224 if(bytes_read == 0 || attrib.id == 0)
1225 {
1226 break;
1227 }
1228 }
1229 tag_count += 1;
1230 }
1231
1232 return table;
1233}
1234
1235SYMS_API SYMS_U64
1236syms_dw_abbrev_offset_from_abbrev_id(SYMS_DwAbbrevTable table, SYMS_U64 abbrev_id)
1237{
1238 SYMS_U64 abbrev_offset = SYMS_U64_MAX;
1239 if(table.count > 0)
1240 {
1241 SYMS_S64 min = 0;
1242 SYMS_S64 max = (SYMS_S64)table.count - 1;
1243 while(min <= max)
1244 {
1245 SYMS_S64 mid = (min + max) / 2;
1246 if (abbrev_id > table.entries[mid].id)
1247 {
1248 min = mid + 1;
1249 }
1250 else if (abbrev_id < table.entries[mid].id)
1251 {
1252 max = mid - 1;
1253 }
1254 else
1255 {
1256 abbrev_offset = table.entries[mid].off;
1257 break;
1258 }
1259 }
1260 }
1261 return abbrev_offset;
1262}

1266
1267//- rjf: .debug_ranges (DWARF V4)
1268
1269SYMS_API SYMS_U64RangeList
1270syms_dw_v4_range_list_from_range_offset(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_U64 addr_size, SYMS_U64 comp_unit_base_addr, SYMS_U64 range_off)
1271{
1272 void *base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Ranges);
1273 SYMS_U64Range rng = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Ranges);
1274
1275 SYMS_U64RangeList list;
1276 syms_memzero_struct(&list);
1277
1278 SYMS_U64 read_off = range_off;
1279 SYMS_U64 base_addr = comp_unit_base_addr;
1280
1281 for(;read_off < rng.max;)
1282 {
1283 SYMS_U64 v0 = 0;
1284 SYMS_U64 v1 = 0;
1285 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &v0);
1286 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &v1);
1287
1288 //- rjf: base address entry
1289 if((addr_size == 4 && v0 == 0xffffffff) ||
1290 (addr_size == 8 && v0 == 0xffffffffffffffff))
1291 {
1292 base_addr = v1;
1293 }
1294 //- rjf: end-of-list entry
1295 else if(v0 == 0 && v1 == 0)
1296 {
1297 break;
1298 }
1299 //- rjf: range list entry
1300 else
1301 {
1302 SYMS_U64 min_addr = v0 + base_addr;
1303 SYMS_U64 max_addr = v1 + base_addr;
1304 syms_u64_range_list_push(arena, &list, syms_make_u64_range(min_addr, max_addr));
1305 }
1306 }
1307
1308 return list;
1309}

1311//- rjf: .debug_loc (DWARF V4)
1312
1313SYMS_API SYMS_LocRangeList
1314syms_dw_v4_location_ranges_from_loc_offset(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_U64 addr_size, SYMS_U64 comp_unit_base_addr, SYMS_U64 offset)
1315{
1316 void *base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Loc);
1317 SYMS_U64Range rng = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Loc);
1318
1319 SYMS_LocRangeList list = {0};
1320
1321 SYMS_U64 read_off = offset;
1322 SYMS_U64 base_addr = comp_unit_base_addr;
1323
1324 for(;read_off < rng.max;)
1325 {
1326 SYMS_U64 v0 = 0;
1327 SYMS_U64 v1 = 0;
1328 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &v0);
1329 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &v1);
1330
1331 //- rjf: base address entry
1332 if((addr_size == 4 && v0 == 0xffffffff) ||
1333 (addr_size == 8 && v0 == 0xffffffffffffffff))
1334 {
1335 base_addr = v1;
1336 }
1337 //- rjf: end-of-list entry
1338 else if(v0 == 0 && v1 == 0)
1339 {
1340 break;
1341 }
1342 //- rjf: location list entry
1343 else
1344 {
1345 SYMS_U64 start_addr = v0 + base_addr;
1346 SYMS_U64 end_addr = v1 + base_addr;
1347
1348 // rjf: push to list
1349 SYMS_LocRangeNode *n = syms_push_array_zero(arena, SYMS_LocRangeNode, 1);
1350 n->loc_range.vrange = syms_make_u64_range(start_addr, end_addr);
1351 n->loc_range.loc_id = (SYMS_LocID)read_off;
1352 SYMS_QueuePush(list.first, list.last, n);
1353 list.count += 1;
1354
1355 // rjf: skip past location description
1356 SYMS_U16 locdesc_length = 0;
1357 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(base, rng, read_off, &locdesc_length);
1358 read_off += locdesc_length;
1359 }
1360 }
1361
1362 return list;
1363}
1364
1365SYMS_API SYMS_Location
1366syms_dw_v4_location_from_loc_id(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_LocID id)
1367{
1368 SYMS_Location result = {0};
1369
1370 void *base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Loc);
1371 SYMS_U64Range sec_range = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Loc);
1372 SYMS_U64 read_off = (SYMS_U64)id;
1373 SYMS_U16 length = 0;
1374 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(base, sec_range, read_off, &length);
1375 void *expr_base = syms_based_range_ptr(base, sec_range, read_off);
1376 SYMS_U64Range expr_range = syms_make_u64_range(read_off, read_off+length);
1377 SYMS_String8 location = syms_dw_expr__transpile_to_eval(arena, dbg, base, expr_range);
1378
1379 // TODO(rjf): wire up `location` to `result`, once SYMS_Location changes to
1380 // returning a SYMS_String8 instead of an op list.
1381
1382 return result;
1383}

1385//- rjf: .debug_pubtypes + .debug_pubnames (DWARF V4)
1386
1387SYMS_API SYMS_DwPubStringsTable
1388syms_dw_v4_pub_strings_table_from_section_kind(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind section_kind)
1389{
1390 SYMS_DwPubStringsTable names_table;
1391 syms_memzero_struct(&names_table);
1392
1393 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
1394
1395 // TODO(rjf): Arbitrary choice.
1396 names_table.size = 16384;
1397 names_table.buckets = syms_push_array_zero(arena, SYMS_DwPubStringsBucket*, names_table.size);
1398
1399 SYMS_DwMode mode = syms_dw_mode_from_sec(dbg->section_map, section_kind);
1400 void *base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, section_kind);
1401 SYMS_U64Range rng = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, section_kind);
1402 SYMS_U64 read_off = 0;
1403
1404 SYMS_U64 off_size = syms_dw_offset_size_from_mode(mode);
1405
1406 SYMS_U64 table_length = 0;
1407 SYMS_U16 unit_version = 0;
1408 SYMS_U64 cu_info_off = 0;
1409 SYMS_U64 cu_info_len = 0;
1410 SYMS_U64 cu_num = 0;
1411 read_off += syms_dw_based_range_read_length(base, rng, read_off, &table_length);
1412 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(base, rng, read_off, &unit_version);
1413 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, off_size, &cu_info_off);
1414 read_off += syms_dw_based_range_read_length(base, rng, read_off, &cu_info_len);
1415 cu_num = syms_dw_uid_from_foff(dbg, cu_info_off);
1416
1417 for(;;)
1418 {
1419 SYMS_U64 info_off = 0;
1420 {
1421 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, off_size, &info_off);
1422 read_off += bytes_read;
1423 if(bytes_read == 0)
1424 {
1425 break;
1426 }
1427 }
1428
1429 //- rjf: if we got a nonzero .debug_info offset, we've found a valid entry.
1430 if(info_off != 0)
1431 {
1432 SYMS_String8 string = syms_based_range_read_string(base, rng, read_off);
1433 read_off += string.size + 1;
1434 SYMS_U64 hash = syms_dw_hash_from_string(string);
1435 SYMS_U64 bucket_idx = hash % names_table.size;
1436 SYMS_DwPubStringsBucket *bucket = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_DwPubStringsBucket, 1);
1437 bucket->next = names_table.buckets[bucket_idx];
1438 bucket->string = string;
1439 bucket->sid = syms_dw_sid_from_info_offset(info_off);
1440 bucket->uid = cu_num;
1441 names_table.buckets[bucket_idx] = bucket;
1442 }
1443
1444 //- rjf: if we did not read a proper entry in the table, we need to try to
1445 // read the header of the next table.
1446 else
1447 {
1448 SYMS_U64 next_table_length = 0;
1449 {
1450 SYMS_U64 bytes_read = syms_dw_based_range_read_length(base, rng, read_off, &next_table_length);
1451 if(bytes_read == 0 || next_table_length == 0)
1452 {
1453 break;
1454 }
1455 read_off += bytes_read;
1456 }
1457 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(base, rng, read_off, &unit_version);
1458 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, off_size, &cu_info_off);
1459 read_off += syms_dw_based_range_read_length(base, rng, read_off, &cu_info_len);
1460 cu_num = syms_dw_uid_from_foff(dbg, cu_info_off);
1461 }
1462 }
1463
1464 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
1465
1466 return names_table;
1467}
1468
1469SYMS_API SYMS_USIDList
1470syms_dw_v4_usid_list_from_pub_table_string(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_DwPubStringsTable tbl, SYMS_String8 string)
1471{
1472 SYMS_USIDList list = {0};
1473 SYMS_U64 hash = syms_dw_hash_from_string(string);
1474 SYMS_U64 idx = hash % tbl.size;
1475 for(SYMS_DwPubStringsBucket *bucket = tbl.buckets[idx]; bucket; bucket = bucket->next)
1476 {
1477 if(syms_string_match(bucket->string, string, 0))
1478 {
1479 SYMS_USIDNode *n = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_USIDNode, 1);
1480 n->usid.uid = bucket->uid;
1481 n->usid.sid = bucket->sid;
1482 SYMS_QueuePush(list.first, list.last, n);
1483 list.count += 1;
1484 }
1485 }
1486 return list;
1487}
1488
1489//- rjf: .debug_str_offsets (DWARF V5)
1490
1491SYMS_API SYMS_U64
1492syms_dw_v5_offset_from_offs_section_base_index(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind section, SYMS_U64 base, SYMS_U64 index)
1493{
1494 SYMS_U64 result = 0;
1495
1496 SYMS_DwMode mode = syms_dw_mode_from_sec(dbg->section_map, section);
1497 void *sec_base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, section);
1498 SYMS_U64Range rng = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, section);
1499 SYMS_U64 read_off = base;
1500
1501 //- rjf: get the length of each entry
1502 SYMS_U64 entry_len = mode == SYMS_DwMode_64Bit ? 8 : 4;
1503
1504 //- rjf: parse the unit's length (not including the length itself)
1505 SYMS_U64 unit_length = 0;
1506 read_off += syms_dw_based_range_read_length(sec_base, rng, read_off, &unit_length);
1507
1508 //- rjf: parse version
1509 SYMS_U16 version = 0;
1510 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(sec_base, rng, read_off, &version);
1511 SYMS_ASSERT_PARANOID(version == 5); // must be 5 as of V5.
1512
1513 //- rjf: parse padding
1514 SYMS_U16 padding = 0;
1515 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(sec_base, rng, read_off, &padding);
1516 SYMS_ASSERT_PARANOID(padding == 0); // must be 0 as of V5.
1517
1518 //- rjf: read
1519 if (unit_length >= sizeof(SYMS_U16)*2)
1520 {
1521 void *entries = (SYMS_U8 *)sec_base + read_off;
1522 SYMS_U64 count = (unit_length - sizeof(SYMS_U16)*2) / entry_len;
1523 if(0 <= index && index < count)
1524 {
1525 switch(entry_len)
1526 {
1527 default: break;
1528 case 4: {result = ((SYMS_U32 *)entries)[index];}break;
1529 case 8: {result = ((SYMS_U64 *)entries)[index];}break;
1530 }
1531 }
1532 }
1533
1534 return result;
1535}
1536
1537//- rjf: .debug_addr parsing
1538
1539SYMS_API SYMS_U64
1540syms_dw_v5_addr_from_addrs_section_base_index(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind section, SYMS_U64 base, SYMS_U64 index)
1541{
1542 SYMS_U64 result = 0;
1543
1544 void *sec_base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, section);
1545 SYMS_U64Range rng = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, section);
1546 SYMS_U64 read_off = base;
1547
1548 //- rjf: parse the unit's length (not including the length itself)
1549 SYMS_U64 unit_length = 0;
1550 read_off += syms_dw_based_range_read_length(sec_base, rng, read_off, &unit_length);
1551
1552 //- rjf: parse version
1553 SYMS_U16 version = 0;
1554 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(sec_base, rng, read_off, &version);
1555 SYMS_ASSERT_PARANOID(version == 5); // must be 5 as of V5.
1556
1557 //- rjf: parse address size
1558 SYMS_U8 address_size = 0;
1559 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(sec_base, rng, read_off, &address_size);
1560
1561 //- rjf: parse segment selector size
1562 SYMS_U8 segment_selector_size = 0;
1563 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(sec_base, rng, read_off, &segment_selector_size);
1564
1565 //- rjf: read
1566 SYMS_U64 entry_size = address_size + segment_selector_size;
1567 SYMS_U64 count = (unit_length - sizeof(SYMS_U16)*2) / entry_size;
1568 if(0 <= index && index < count)
1569 {
1570 void *entry = (SYMS_U8 *)syms_based_range_ptr(sec_base, rng, read_off) + entry_size*index;
1571 SYMS_U64Range entry_rng = syms_make_u64_range(0, entry_size);
1572 SYMS_U64 segment = 0;
1573 SYMS_U64 addr = 0;
1574 syms_based_range_read(entry, entry_rng, 0, sizeof(segment), &segment);
1575 syms_based_range_read(entry, entry_rng, segment_selector_size, sizeof(addr), &addr);
1576 result = addr;
1577 }
1578
1579 return result;
1580}
1581
1582//- rjf: .debug_rnglists + .debug_loclists parsing
1583
1584SYMS_API SYMS_U64
1585syms_dw_v5_sec_offset_from_rnglist_or_loclist_section_base_index(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind section_kind, SYMS_U64 base, SYMS_U64 index)
1586{
1587 //
1588 // NOTE(rjf): This is only appropriate to call when SYMS_DwFormKind_RNGLISTX is
1589 // used to access a range list, *OR* when SYMS_DwFormKind_LOCLISTX is used to
1590 // access a location list. Otherwise, SYMS_DwFormKind_SEC_OFFSET is required.
1591 //
1592 // See the DWARF V5 spec (February 13, 2017), page 242. (rnglists)
1593 // See the DWARF V5 spec (February 13, 2017), page 215. (loclists)
1594 //
1595
1596 SYMS_U64 result = 0;
1597 SYMS_DwMode mode = syms_dw_mode_from_sec(dbg->section_map, section_kind);
1598 void *sec_base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, section_kind);
1599 SYMS_U64Range rng = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, section_kind);
1600 SYMS_U64 read_off = base;
1601
1602 //- rjf: get the length of each entry
1603 SYMS_U64 entry_len = mode == SYMS_DwMode_64Bit ? 8 : 4;
1604
1605 //- rjf: parse the unit's length (not including the length itself)
1606 SYMS_U64 unit_length = 0;
1607 read_off += syms_dw_based_range_read_length(sec_base, rng, read_off, &unit_length);
1608
1609 //- rjf: parse version
1610 SYMS_U16 version = 0;
1611 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(sec_base, rng, read_off, &version);
1612 SYMS_ASSERT_PARANOID(version == 5); // must be 5 as of V5.
1613
1614 //- rjf: parse address size
1615 SYMS_U8 address_size = 0;
1616 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(sec_base, rng, read_off, &address_size);
1617
1618 //- rjf: parse segment selector size
1619 SYMS_U8 segment_selector_size = 0;
1620 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(sec_base, rng, read_off, &segment_selector_size);
1621
1622 //- rjf: parse offset entry count
1623 SYMS_U32 offset_entry_count = 0;
1624 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(sec_base, rng, read_off, &offset_entry_count);
1625
1626 //- rjf: read from offsets array
1627 SYMS_U64 table_off = read_off;
1628 void *offsets_arr = syms_based_range_ptr(sec_base, rng, read_off);
1629 if(0 <= index && index < (SYMS_U64)offset_entry_count)
1630 {
1631 SYMS_U64 rnglist_offset = 0;
1632 switch(entry_len)
1633 {
1634 default: break;
1635 case 4: rnglist_offset = ((SYMS_U32 *)offsets_arr)[index]; break;
1636 case 8: rnglist_offset = ((SYMS_U64 *)offsets_arr)[index]; break;
1637 }
1638 result = rnglist_offset+table_off;
1639 }
1640
1641 return result;
1642}
1643
1644SYMS_API SYMS_U64RangeList
1645syms_dw_v5_range_list_from_rnglist_offset(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind section, SYMS_U64 addr_size, SYMS_U64 addr_section_base, SYMS_U64 offset)
1646{
1647 SYMS_U64RangeList list = {0};
1648
1649 SYMS_U64 read_off = offset;
1650 void *base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, section);
1651 SYMS_U64Range rng = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, section);
1652
1653 SYMS_U64 base_addr = 0;
1654
1655 for(SYMS_B32 done = syms_false; !done;)
1656 {
1657 SYMS_U8 kind8 = 0;
1658 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(base, rng, read_off, &kind8);
1659 SYMS_DwRngListEntryKind kind = (SYMS_DwRngListEntryKind)kind8;
1660
1661 switch(kind)
1662 {
1663 //- rjf: can be used in split and non-split units:
1664 default:
1665 case SYMS_DwRngListEntryKind_EndOfList:
1666 {
1667 done = syms_true;
1668 }break;
1669
1670 case SYMS_DwRngListEntryKind_BaseAddressX:
1671 {
1672 SYMS_U64 base_addr_idx = 0;
1673 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &base_addr_idx);
1674 base_addr = syms_dw_v5_addr_from_addrs_section_base_index(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Addr, addr_section_base, base_addr_idx);
1675 }break;
1676
1677 case SYMS_DwRngListEntryKind_StartxEndx:
1678 {
1679 SYMS_U64 start_addr_idx = 0;
1680 SYMS_U64 end_addr_idx = 0;
1681 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &start_addr_idx);
1682 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &end_addr_idx);
1683 SYMS_U64 start_addr = syms_dw_v5_addr_from_addrs_section_base_index(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Addr, addr_section_base, start_addr_idx);
1684 SYMS_U64 end_addr = syms_dw_v5_addr_from_addrs_section_base_index(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Addr, addr_section_base, end_addr_idx);
1685 syms_u64_range_list_push(arena, &list, syms_make_u64_range(start_addr, end_addr));
1686 }break;
1687
1688 case SYMS_DwRngListEntryKind_StartxLength:
1689 {
1690 SYMS_U64 start_addr_idx = 0;
1691 SYMS_U64 length = 0;
1692 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &start_addr_idx);
1693 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &length);
1694 SYMS_U64 start_addr = syms_dw_v5_addr_from_addrs_section_base_index(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Addr, addr_section_base, start_addr_idx);
1695 SYMS_U64 end_addr = start_addr + length;
1696 syms_u64_range_list_push(arena, &list, syms_make_u64_range(start_addr, end_addr));
1697 }break;
1698
1699 case SYMS_DwRngListEntryKind_OffsetPair:
1700 {
1701 SYMS_U64 start_offset = 0;
1702 SYMS_U64 end_offset = 0;
1703 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &start_offset);
1704 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &end_offset);
1705 syms_u64_range_list_push(arena, &list, syms_make_u64_range(start_offset + base_addr, end_offset + base_addr));
1706 }break;
1707
1708 //- rjf: non-split units only:
1709
1710 case SYMS_DwRngListEntryKind_BaseAddress:
1711 {
1712 SYMS_U64 new_base_addr = 0;
1713 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &new_base_addr);
1714 base_addr = new_base_addr;
1715 }break;
1716
1717 case SYMS_DwRngListEntryKind_StartEnd:
1718 {
1719 SYMS_U64 start = 0;
1720 SYMS_U64 end = 0;
1721 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &start);
1722 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &end);
1723 syms_u64_range_list_push(arena, &list, syms_make_u64_range(start, end));
1724 }break;
1725
1726 case SYMS_DwRngListEntryKind_StartLength:
1727 {
1728 SYMS_U64 start = 0;
1729 SYMS_U64 length = 0;
1730 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &start);
1731 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &length);
1732 syms_u64_range_list_push(arena, &list, syms_make_u64_range(start, start+length));
1733 }break;
1734 }
1735 }
1736
1737 return list;
1738}
1739
1740//- rjf: .debug_loclists parsing
1741
1742SYMS_API SYMS_LocRangeList
1743syms_dw_v5_location_ranges_from_loclist_offset(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind section, SYMS_U64 addr_size, SYMS_U64 addr_section_base, SYMS_U64 offset)
1744{
1745 SYMS_LocRangeList list = {0};
1746
1747 SYMS_U64 read_off = offset;
1748 void *base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, section);
1749 SYMS_U64Range rng = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, section);
1750
1751 SYMS_U64 base_addr = 0;
1752
1753 for(SYMS_B32 done = syms_false; !done;)
1754 {
1755 SYMS_U8 kind8 = 0;
1756 read_off += syms_based_range_read_struct(base, rng, read_off, &kind8);
1757 SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind kind = (SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind)kind8;
1758
1759 SYMS_B32 do_counted_location_description = 0;
1760 SYMS_U64 start_addr = 0;
1761 SYMS_U64 end_addr = 0;
1762
1763 switch(kind)
1764 {
1765 //- rjf: can be used in split and non-split units:
1766 default:
1767 case SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind_EndOfList:
1768 {
1769 done = syms_true;
1770 }break;
1771
1772 case SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind_BaseAddressX:
1773 {
1774 SYMS_U64 base_addr_idx = 0;
1775 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &base_addr_idx);
1776 base_addr = syms_dw_v5_addr_from_addrs_section_base_index(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Addr, addr_section_base, base_addr_idx);
1777 }break;
1778
1779 case SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind_StartXEndX:
1780 {
1781 SYMS_U64 start_addr_idx = 0;
1782 SYMS_U64 end_addr_idx = 0;
1783 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &start_addr_idx);
1784 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &end_addr_idx);
1785 start_addr = syms_dw_v5_addr_from_addrs_section_base_index(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Addr, addr_section_base, start_addr_idx);
1786 end_addr = syms_dw_v5_addr_from_addrs_section_base_index(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Addr, addr_section_base, end_addr_idx);
1787 do_counted_location_description = 1;
1788 }break;
1789
1790 case SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind_StartXLength:
1791 {
1792 SYMS_U64 start_addr_idx = 0;
1793 SYMS_U64 length = 0;
1794 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &start_addr_idx);
1795 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &length);
1796 start_addr = syms_dw_v5_addr_from_addrs_section_base_index(data, dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind_Addr, addr_section_base, start_addr_idx);
1797 end_addr = start_addr + length;
1798 do_counted_location_description = 1;
1799 }break;
1800
1801 case SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind_OffsetPair:
1802 {
1803 SYMS_U64 start_offset = 0;
1804 SYMS_U64 end_offset = 0;
1805 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &start_offset);
1806 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &end_offset);
1807 start_addr = start_offset + base_addr;
1808 end_addr = end_offset + base_addr;
1809 do_counted_location_description = 1;
1810 }break;
1811
1812 case SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind_DefaultLocation:
1813 {
1814 do_counted_location_description = 1;
1815 }break;
1816
1817 //- rjf: non-split units only:
1818
1819 case SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind_BaseAddress:
1820 {
1821 SYMS_U64 new_base_addr = 0;
1822 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &new_base_addr);
1823 base_addr = new_base_addr;
1824 }break;
1825
1826 case SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind_StartEnd:
1827 {
1828 SYMS_U64 start = 0;
1829 SYMS_U64 end = 0;
1830 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &start);
1831 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &end);
1832 start_addr = start;
1833 end_addr = end;
1834 do_counted_location_description = 1;
1835 }break;
1836
1837 case SYMS_DwLocListEntryKind_StartLength:
1838 {
1839 SYMS_U64 start = 0;
1840 SYMS_U64 length = 0;
1841 read_off += syms_based_range_read(base, rng, read_off, addr_size, &start);
1842 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &length);
1843 start_addr = start;
1844 end_addr = start+length;
1845 do_counted_location_description = 1;
1846 }break;
1847 }
1848
1849 //- rjf: parse a counted location description + push to result, if valid
1850 if(do_counted_location_description)
1851 {
1852 SYMS_LocRangeNode *n = syms_push_array_zero(arena, SYMS_LocRangeNode, 1);
1853 n->loc_range.vrange.min = start_addr;
1854 n->loc_range.vrange.max = end_addr;
1855 n->loc_range.loc_id = read_off;
1856 SYMS_QueuePush(list.first, list.last, n);
1857 list.count += 1;
1858
1859 // rjf: skip past the location description
1860 SYMS_U64 locdesc_length = 0;
1861 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, rng, read_off, &locdesc_length);
1862 read_off += locdesc_length;
1863 }
1864 }
1865
1866 return list;
1867}
1868
1869SYMS_API SYMS_Location
1870syms_dw_v5_location_from_loclist_id(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_DwDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_DwSectionKind section, SYMS_LocID id)
1871{
1872 SYMS_Location result = {0};
1873
1874 void *base = syms_dw_sec_base_from_dbg(data, dbg, section);
1875 SYMS_U64Range sec_range = syms_dw_sec_range_from_dbg(dbg, section);
1876 SYMS_U64 read_off = (SYMS_U64)id;
1877 SYMS_U64 length = 0;
1878 read_off += syms_based_range_read_uleb128(base, sec_range, read_off, &length);
1879 void *expr_base = syms_based_range_ptr(base, sec_range, read_off);
1880 SYMS_U64Range expr_range = syms_make_u64_range(read_off, read_off+length);
1881 SYMS_String8 location = syms_dw_expr__transpile_to_eval(arena, dbg, base, expr_range);
1882
1883 // TODO(rjf): wire up `location` to `result`, once SYMS_Location changes to
1884 // returning a SYMS_String8 instead of an op list.
1885
1886 return result;
1887}
